dialogue.speaker: Mira
dialogue.text: What are you eating to be so skinny? There's so much delicious food in Vietnam and you don't eat it?

dialogue.speaker: Michael
dialogue.text: I'm on a diet to lose weight. Don't you see that we Americans are usually fat? I want to live more khỏe mạnh.

dialogue.speaker: Mira
dialogue.text: What kind of diet makes you look so weak? We Russians believe that men should be khỏe mạnh, must ăn a lot of meat. You need to ăn more!

dialogue.speaker: Michael
dialogue.text: Being khỏe mạnh doesn't mean you have to ăn a lot of meat. I ăn plenty of vegetables and tập exercise every day. Would you like to tập gym with me?

dialogue.speaker: Mira
dialogue.text: Tập gym? No way! Chess is the best way to keep the mind khỏe mạnh. But... if you want to be truly khỏe mạnh, I could cook you a traditional Russian borscht...
